title: ammophila arenaria var. arundinacea
intro: Ammophila arenaria var. arundinacea, commonly known as Marram Grass, is a type of coastal grass species native to the European coasts and the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Marram Grass include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Marram Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
